name: Ozaki Issei
source:
A student who is going to graduate from college next spring. Despite the current recession, he already has a job he can start with after graduation, thanks to his father who is a close acquaintance to his future boss Mr. Takasugi. Aside from a recent breakup from his girlfriend for unknown reasons, everything seems to be laid out perfectly for Issei.

[from [url=http://engbishoujo.tripod.com/secretwivesreview.html]Lady Phoenix's Wonderful World of English Bishoujo Games[/url]]
